surfaces_verified.notes: CLI entrypoints (rig-relay, rig-relay-acp) smoke pass. pyproject.toml parseable. uv sync works.
produce_ci_evidence() produces schema-valid artifacts. Verdict=pass. Adversarial tests pass.
RigClient class exists with governed operations, capability gating, content-light guarantees. Operations are v0 stubs — no real IO bridging. 13/14 tests pass (1 pre-existing import hygiene failure).
NON_INTERACTIVE_DISABLED_TOOLS defined. ForkSessionParams bug fixed. 7 new error codes. Structured refusals with remediation.
8/10 promotion gates pass. Schema-valid models. State machine complete. External A2A disabled. 2 gates deferred to post-alpha.
RigMCPServer class exists with 16 tools, 6 resources, 3 prompts. Tiered permission model. Transport binding (stdio) not wired — post-alpha.
No raw secrets in production code. Secret patterns in test fixtures only (false positives). No raw tokens, OAuth codes, private keys. Content-light enforced. No DevFileTokenStore as default.
Site render script exists and parses. Schema-governed page models exist.
All 14 blockers tracked. 12 resolved. 2 classified as known_limitations. Verdict: release_candidate_with_known_limitations.

claims_supported.claim: Rig Relay installs on macOS Python 3.12+ via uv sync with working CLI entrypoints.
253 schema-governed JSON artifacts validate. All protocol surfaces, CI evidence, release gates, coordination, telemetry, and documentation are schema-backed.
All protocol surfaces enforce content-light doctrine: no raw file contents, secrets, or private data. SHA-256 hashing for all content-derived values.
CI evidence surface produces schema-valid structured artifacts with SHA-256 verification, runner classification, and adversarial hardening.
A2A, MCP, ACP, and SDK protocol models are schema-governed, content-light, and enforce capability gating.
No raw credentials in code. Writes refused by default. Network disabled by default. Live operations require explicit opt-in.
Telemetry is local-first, degradation mode when disabled, debug packet quarantine, content-light guarantees.
